text: 10月10日，中国证监会党委书记、主席吴清在北京召开座谈会。座谈会上，大家一致认为，我国宏观经济稳中向好，产业结构转型持续深化，资本市场运行总体稳健，多层次市场功能有效发挥，虽然面临一些风险挑战，但高质量发展的态势不会改变，对经济运行和资本市场充满信心。 财信证券首席经济学家、研究发展中心总经理袁闯认为，证监会座谈会释放积极信号，A股中长期向好趋势没有改变。
text_en: On October 10, Wu Qing, Party Secretary and Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, held a symposium in Beijing. At the symposium, participants unanimously agreed that China's macroeconomic situation is stable and improving, industrial structure transformation continues to deepen, capital market operations are generally stable, and the functions of the multi-tiered market are effectively utilized. Although facing some risks and challenges, the trend of high-quality development will not change, and there is full confidence in economic operations and the capital market. Yuan Chuang, Chief Economist of Caixin Securities and General Manager of the Research and Development Center, believes that the CSRC symposium released positive signals, and the medium- to long-term positive trend of A-shares has not changed.
